body:
Preserve calibration workbook cells as source evidence before interpreting peptide identities, nominal doses or MS signals. The new internal reader keeps exact numeric strings, absent/empty/zero distinctions, formula caches, style references, addressed cells and worksheet metadata. It rejects duplicate encodings and invalid document/relationship structures rather than silently dropping data.

This is the first implementation unit for #849. It does not ingest PXD024917 into the catalog, assign acquisition identities, resolve isotope contradictions or create training labels. Those steps still require qualification of the deposited transition exports. Version: 2.0.42.

Validation: local `./format.sh`, `./lint.sh` and `git diff --check` pass. The local `./test.sh -k nontryptic_workbooks` attempt was refused before pytest at 2.02 GiB against the unchanged 2.5 GiB startup requirement; it is not a passing test. Synthetic fixtures cover literal preservation, formula/blank states, rich text, malformed and duplicate source encodings, path handling and archive limits. Hosted [Tests run40226053061](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/actions/runs/40226053061) is fully green for head0263dc6 against base85ff2c81 (merge3fefeb1): unit tests pass on Python3.10–3.14; the3.11 run reports3,621passed/two optional-dependency skips and99% reader line coverage; all96 integration tests and combined coverage upload pass. [Original-source replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/155f719b85130367bff37f7d514c60dcb3a66502/experiments/2026-10-25_1857_codex_nontryptic-transition-lineage/README.md) now passes for the pinned reader:42,941export cells independently match,54reported forms are source-matched and684group sums replay. Acquisition mapping, isotope atoms and some published aggregate signals remain unresolved; typed ingestion and biological evaluation remain pending.

Public PyPI upload remains pending explicit user approval after the previous release upload was rejected by automatic approval review. No upload is part of this draft PR action.
